subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should OpenClaw accept native backup exclude controls now, and what should the default, ignore-file, protected-path, and external-asset semantics be before this PR can merge?
rationale: The feature is useful and linked to open backup issues, but it defines backup completeness and security-sensitive recovery behavior that automation should not finalize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow and repair this PR
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical path after rebase, explicit ignore-file/default decisions, external-asset filtering or fail-closed behavior, and real backup proof.

options.title: Land explicit excludes first
options.body: Accept only explicit `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` behavior while deferring smart defaults and auto-loaded ignore files to a later design.

options.title: Defer native excludes
options.body: Keep core backup scope coarse for now and leave plugin/workaround approaches as the supported alternative until maintainers reopen the direction.
